resources.string: Keep the password separately. Restoring on another device requires it. DSHA cannot recover it.
Protect the tar.gz with a backup password so you can restore it on a new device.
The selected data may include credentials saved in chats, attachments and files.
Choose a backup. Encrypted backups require a password. Review the verified scope before restoring.
Enter the password used to create this backup.
Encrypted rescue exports contain backup data only. Plaintext rescue exports also include the diagnostic summary when available.
This copy keeps its original password. Use that password to restore it on a new device.
Export as plaintext for compatibility. Anyone with the file can read everything in it, including secrets in chats and attachments.
Uninstalling removes automatic copies and their device key. Before moving or uninstalling, export with your own backup password and save the file outside the app.
